scope_reason: The native engine has no audio and the SPEC's GPU contract needs none: the vanilla playSound paths are documented empty on both sides (csrc/engine/entity.c, csrc/engine/blockcb.c, csrc/engine/activate.c). No world state rides the packet.
notes: The vanilla playSoundEffect call sites keep their argument evaluation (the Random draws) because those change RNG state; the sound itself is dropped.
